messages:
Nori: Quick note from pairing with a contractorthey hit a confusing auth mismatch in the JS sampleapp. Thought I'd surface it here.
Ben: What mismatch?
Nori: The README and .env.example use different var names: README shows REDWOOD_API_KEY but .env.example and the dockerfile use REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY. Locally they set both and things behaved inconsistently between the Node and Go SDK.
Asha: Oof. Service-key vs api-key naming is a leftover from the first pass. Node SDK currently prefers REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY when present (legacy), Go ignores it and picks REDWOOD_API_KEY. New users copy .env.example -> working in one language, failing in another.
Nori: Repro used two simple steps:
```
# .env
REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY=sk_legacy_xyz
REDWOOD_API_KEY=pk_new_abc
npm start -> works (uses legacy service key)
# run go sample -> fails with 403 (uses new pk which is project-scoped)
```
Ben: How about rotation behavior? Any surprises there?
Asha: Yes. The Node SDK caches the key in memory and emits Debug logs like "using legacy key" but on key rotate the library does not clear the cache on 401s. So background retry keeps failing silently; only when user looks at verbose logs do they see the mismatch.
docbot: Reminder: planned deprecation of REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY was announced. See internal/announcements/2026-03.
Nori: Short fixes we discussed:
- Normalize all quickstarts to one canonical env var: REDWOOD_API_KEY. Remove REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY from .env.example.
- Add a startup diagnostic in sampleapp that prints which env var wins (non-sensitive) and a hint if legacy alias present: "Using REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY (legacy). Prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY; see docs.link".
- SDK change: on any 401 that includes X-Redwood-Scope header mismatch, clear cached auth and retry once after re-reading env. Also surface a clear error: "Auth failed: possible key scope mismatch or rotated key. Check REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT/REDWOOD_ORG."
- Docs: small section in quickstart "I get 403 in one language but not another" with examples.
Ben: I'll tackle the sampleapp cleanup PR (normalize .env and add startup diagnostic). Asha, can you handle the SDK 401 handling + unit tests? If you add the log line we can avoid most of these support pings.
Asha: Yep. Will also add a tiny telemetry ping (non-identifying) on 401-with-scope-mismatch after privacy sign-off.
Nori: I'll file the docs ticket and update README examples. Also will add a short troubleshooting blurb to the onboarding checklist.
docbot: Created ticket DEVX-998: "quickstart env parity: remove legacy service key alias and add startup diagnostics" at 3501234608.
Ben: PR opened: https://git.example/redwood/sampleapp/pull/799. Includes .env cleanup and small printed diagnostic.
Asha: SDK PR will follow today. Will ping here when ready.
Nori: Thanks all 2B nice catch from the contractor saved us a bunch of future confusion.
